English.Char_Desc_2000:
DriverGeek lists every driver installed on a Windows machine and shows the driver updates Windows hides.
Windows Update files driver updates under Optional updates, four clicks deep, where almost nobody looks. DriverGeek surfaces them in one list with version, date and publisher.
It uses Windows Update's own catalogue rather than a third-party driver database, so nothing unusual is ever downloaded and no unsigned driver is ever offered. Nothing is installed without an explicit tick.
No Pro tier, no subscription, no ads and no bundled offers. Windows 10 1809 or later, 64-bit. Free to use, including at work.
